name: PM-KISAN
body: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Provides Rs 6,000 every year directly into bank accounts of families that own cultivable farmland.

criteria.text: Applicant must be a farmer
Household must own cultivable agricultural farmland

documents: Land ownership record (Khasra or Khatauni or Land passbook)

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
body: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: Provides a free LPG gas cylinder connection to adult women from low-income households.

criteria.text: Only for women applicants
Applicant must be 18 years of age or older
Household income must be Rs 2,50,000 or below

documents: Ration card (BPL or Priority household card)

name: MGNREGA (Rural Work Guarantee)
summary: Guarantees 100 days of paid manual work each year for adult members living in village areas.

criteria.text: Only for households living in a rural village area
Applicant must be 18 years of age or older

documents: MGNREGA Job Card (or Gram Panchayat registration form)

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
summary: Provides free hospital medical treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per year for your entire family.

criteria.text: Household income must be Rs 2,50,000 or below

documents: Ration card or family identity card

name: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin)
summary: Provides money from the government to build a permanent brick house for poor families in villages.

criteria.text: Only for households located in a rural village area
Household annual income must be Rs 1,00,000 or below
Applicant must not be a salaried employee

documents: Declaration confirming your family does not own a brick house

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
body: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Provides free skill training, tool kit money of Rs 15,000, and low-interest loans for craftspeople and artisans.

criteria.text: Applicant must be 18 years of age or older
Only for traditional artisans, craftspeople, and independent workers

documents: Self-declaration or certificate of traditional artisan trade

name: PM Mudra Yojana
summary: Provides bank loans up to Rs 10 lakh to start, run, or expand a small shop, trade, or local business.

criteria.text: Applicant must be 18 years of age or older
Only for small shopkeepers, traders, and self-employed people

name: National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
summary: Provides a monthly government pension for senior citizens aged 60 and older from low-income families.

criteria.text: Applicant must be 60 years of age or older
Household annual income must be Rs 1,00,000 or below

documents: Age proof document (Voter ID, School certificate, or Doctor age slip)

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
summary: Provides an assured monthly pension of Rs 3,000 after age 60 for unorganised daily wage workers.

criteria.text: Entry age must be between 18 and 40 years of age
Only for daily wage labourers, unorganised workers, and street workers
Monthly income must be Rs 15,000 or below (annual Rs 2,50,000 or below)

documents: Savings Bank or Jan Dhan account passbook

name: Atal Pension Yojana
body: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
summary: Government-backed pension scheme providing Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 every month after you turn 60.

criteria.text: Must join between 18 and 40 years of age
Applicant must not be a formal salaried employee covered by EPF
Income must be within non-taxpayer brackets
